verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Godot uses an interpreted scripting language (GDScript) and that editor plugins can be built 'without even reloading the editor' [godot-docs-4][godot-docs-13], plus community sentiment that Godot 'starts up in seconds' compared to heavier engines [godot-comm-16], hinting at a lightweight edit-run cycle. However, there is no direct documentation or first-party claim about hot-reloading running scripts or near-instant preview after a script change during actual gameplay testing. Missing for 10: explicit hot-reload/live-script-update documentation, measured edit-run latency, and independent hands-on confirmation of fast iteration specifically for gameplay scripting.
